D3 | note function | Comment says "Read INSIDE the lock" but the lock is acquired before reading, so the comment matches.
D4 | _parse_until | Branch for ISO timestamp: if parsed.tzinfo is false, calls .astimezone() which adds timezone info; but then returns a timezone-aware datetime, which is correct.
